pages.rationale: Frame 1 is reproduced closely: header counts, the seven-way filter seg, workspace dropdown, the three needs-you cards with the right borders and copy, the five table groups with the right ids/captions/status pills/actions, the collapsed Finished group, the Manifest inbox drawer and a per-kind rail. All 20 manifest states resolve with no console errors and no dead clicks. Deductions: the purple `blind` badge the frame draws on the q-18/q-19 rows is missing from the table; the time column collides with the row action in the Finished group; the Mark... popover survives a route change and covers the cancel modal; the cancel dialog subtitle is clipped mid-word; the queue rail omits the pace figure.

findings.title: blind badge missing from review-queue table rows
findings.detail: Frame 1 draws a purple `blind` chip beside the job title on q-18 Training windows and q-19 Model verification, and spec 7c.1 lists 'blind badge' as part of the Review queues group. The built rows show only the title and the left-of-total caption; the badge appears only in the right rail once a queue is selected.

findings.title: Mark... popover stays open across navigation and covers the cancel modal
findings.detail: Open the Mark... menu on j-0217, then navigate to #/jobs?sel=r-0431&modal=cancel&job=r-0431. [data-testid=mark-menu-j-0217] is still in the DOM (verified by query) and renders on top of the cancel dialog, overlapping the confirm button. Popovers should close on a route change.

findings.title: time column overlaps the row action in the Finished group
findings.detail: Rows in 'Finished and cancelled today' render as '09:30 · 14 mi0pen' and '09:58 · 22 m0pen' - the time text runs under the Open link. The frame keeps time and action in separate columns.

findings.title: cancel dialog subtitle clipped mid-word
findings.detail: The dialog header reads 'Cancel r-0431?  the run stops where it is; no...'; the DOM text continues 'nothing already computed is thrown away'. The inline subtitle has no room at 1440x900.

findings.title: queue rail omits the pace figure
findings.detail: The inventory's queue rail is 'left of total, pace, blind badge, Open in Review'. The rail shows 33/40, '7 left', the blind note and Open in Review, but not the '~1.9 s each' style pace the table row carries.

pages.rationale: Essentially a match for frame 2: title with both badges, the meta line with 721 h and the start stamp, the four stage cards joined by chevrons with their two caption lines and state badges, the timeline, the Stage 3 result card with the locked path, Show in folder, all six checks with right-aligned evidence, the info strip and Continue/Look again, and the four 'Other ways forward' blocks with the disabled Run locally and its reason. Waiting, looking, continuing, finished, cancelled, new-script and unknown-run all work with no console errors. Deductions: timeline labels collide in the finished state, the header breadcrumb goes stale, the added footer chip uses purple as a primary-action colour, and one stage caption truncates.

findings.title: timeline labels overlap after Continue
findings.detail: The timeline renders '08:05 paused · SLURM script cre[at]ed08:20 marked submitted' - the 'created' label runs into the next dot's time. Adding the 'now continued' point compresses the track without re-spacing labels.

findings.title: header breadcrumb still says 'paused at stage 3 of 4' after the run finishes
findings.detail: The title badge changes to 'finished · all 4 stages' but the shell header still reads 'r-0431  Discovery run · paused at stage 3 of 4'.

findings.title: purple used as the primary-action colour on the footer chip
findings.detail: 'Open j-0217' in the added footer strip is rgb(142,92,247). Spec 3 reserves blue for the primary action and purple for a second algorithm in a comparison / family affinity; no purple appears anywhere in the four jobs frames.

findings.title: stage caption truncated
findings.detail: Stage 2's caption reads 'm = 600 s · ~6.4 h locally, over th...'. Spec 3 calls these plain-language captions load-bearing and the frames show them whole.

pages.rationale: The modal reproduces frame 3 almost verbatim - file card with size/provenance and 'Choose another file', the locked 'will be placed at' path with 'named by Storage', the six checks with their right-aligned evidence, the red refusal card with both buttons and the exact sentence, the amber no-null-draws note, and the footer with 'nothing is placed until every check passes' and a disabled Place button. The extra states earn the score: a genuinely different held-out (M4_aug, D6) refusal with the later checks marked 'not checked', a passing state, a passing-with-no-nulls state, the file picker popover, and a Place that closes the modal and continues the run. Deduction: the subtitle is clipped, losing a canon value.

findings.title: modal subtitle clipped
findings.detail: The header renders the subtitle inline and truncates it: 'r-0431 · Discovery run mp_drops_v3 · stage 3 of 4 · Matrix profile on M2_aug fs1 CH2_A1-C...'. Frame 3 puts the subtitle on its own line under the title and shows the canon channel span CH2_A1-CH4_A2 in full.

pages.rationale: Frame 4 is well reproduced: the hand-marked status pill chain with its four timestamps and 'set when the manifest arrives', the amber 3.3x reminder with its exact two sentences and three actions, the editable cluster job id, profile select, locked return path and estimate, the dark script block with Copy/Save .sh, and the Manifest inbox with the j-0212 contents list, four import checks and the disabled Imported button, plus the 'stage results for paused runs' list. Marking, snoozing, importing and the per-id variants (j-0217 running, j-0212 imported, j-0209 failed, j-9999 unknown) all work. Deductions: purple primary buttons against spec 3, a stale snooze reminder left standing after the job is marked finished, Copy/Save moved off the label row, one inbox line that does not read as the frame does, and a missing demo chip on the empty state.

findings.title: snooze reminder survives the job becoming finished and contradicts it
findings.detail: Click 'Still running · remind me in 3 h' on j-0214, then import its manifest. The status row shows finished and 'Finished · manifest imported 07:34', but the panel above still reads 'Reminder snoozed · it comes back in 3 h - j-0214 is still marked running at 3.3x its estimate. Nothing changed on the cluster.' with Mark finished / Mark failed. Two contradictory claims about the same job on one screen.

findings.title: purple used as the primary-action colour
findings.detail: 'New SLURM script' on j-0209 and 'Open job' in the jobs.all cluster rail are both rgb(142,92,247). Spec 3: blue is the primary action, purple is a second algorithm in a comparison / family affinity. Frame 2 draws New SLURM script as a plain outlined button and no jobs frame uses purple for an action.

findings.title: Copy / Save .sh moved below the script block
findings.detail: Frame 4 puts Copy and Save .sh on the right of the 'script' label row, level with it. The build puts them as two buttons under the code block, adding a row the frame does not have.

findings.title: stage-results line for r-0431 differs from the frame
findings.detail: The inbox lists 'r-0431 · stage 3 · not in its root yet'; frame 4 shows 'r-0431 · stage 3 · result arrived 14:31'. Internally consistent with r-0431's default waiting state, but it does not read as the frame does.

findings.title: demo data chip missing on the unknown-job state
findings.detail: Every other jobs state carries the dashed 'demo data' chip in the header. #/jobs/cluster/j-9999 renders the header as 'Jobs | j-9999  not a cluster job' with no chip.
